form.served_status: the served table's own standing beside the ELEMENT's figures the file carries per element of record: the csv's d99_served_status is the served row's d1_of_record_status as written (point; bound: below…; bound: above…; withheld — entry 252's depth-one rows withhold the 1%, 3%, 5% and 10% crossings at one answer a task), 'absent' where the served row carries no such leaf, 'no served row' where the table has no row; the levels file carries the same standing as a CLASS per level and per joint span (its own form's served_status sentence); a consumer draws a level or a span as of record only where its standing is point or a bound
form.fail99: where the fitted AVERAGE failure curve crosses a 99% failure rate (1% reliability): the element's own level table (the exact per-draw crossing of the average curve; the middle rule on an engine-of-record element with the quantiles over all draws and the censored ones beyond the ends, the first-upward rule at grid resolution on a September element with the quantiles over the uncensored draws — the row's `rule` and `locator`), read at the two table levels bracketing 0.99 (`fail99_levels`) and interpolated linearly in z; the band the 10th and 90th percentiles over draws; the status by the censored shares as every crossing of record: more than half the draws beyond the hardest task is 'bound: above' with the z the hardest task's (the grid's hardest point; the top of the scale), beyond the easiest 'bound: below', else 'point'; a September table whose median is empty at the level (every draw censored) gives the bound alone, no band; an element without a table falls back to the crossing of the average curve's posterior-median logit on the grid (rule 'curve-median', the band from the 90th and 10th quantile curves)
form.d50_d99: the crossings of record (the 50% failure crossing; the 1% failure crossing, 99% reliability): where the served table carries the row, its z and cri80 edges as the pages print them (d50_d99_source 'table row') — the BAND OF RECORD since 15 Oct 2026 on the wave 1+2 board and the as-judged table is the SHORTEST range holding 80% of the per-draw middle-rule crossings, the median unchanged, while a table not re-tabled carries the equal-tailed band still; else the element's estimands_avg (the equal-tailed band)
form.span: fail99_z − d99_z, the width of the curve's transition in difficulty units; 'point' when both ends are points, 'bound: at least' when the 99% crossing is bound above the tasks and D99 is a point, else 'bound'; span_lo and span_hi the widest band from the two ends' bands (the joint per-draw band would need the 99% crossing per draw, which the elements do not store) — the two ends' bands of two forms where the table carries the band of record (D99 the shortest 80%, fail99 the 10th/90th percentiles over draws: the elements store quantiles, not draws, so the shortest form cannot be read for fail99 or the levels)
form.gradient: (logit 0.99 − logit 0.01) / span = 9.1902 / span, logit units per difficulty unit — the average slope of the curve across its transition; on a 'bound: at least' span an upper bound ('bound: at most')
form.span_d99_d50: the EXACT joint span from the 1% to the 50% failure crossing: the same draw's two crossings subtracted over the stored per-draw crossings (every tenth draw), a censored crossing at the grid end it crosses beyond, the median and the 10th/90th over all draws; 'bound' when more than half the draws carry a censored end (span_d99_d50_censored_share)
form.aoe: the AVERAGE OUTCOME ENTROPY OF THE FITTED CURVE, in nats — the Shannon entropy of the fitted average failure rate at each difficulty, H(p) = −p ln p − (1−p) ln(1−p), integrated over the logit difficulty axis z with the weight the density of a Beta prior on the failure rate carried onto the logit space: aoe_uniform_* Beta(1,1) — the weight σ(z)(1−σ(z)), the logistic density, the same as integrating uniformly over the 0-to-100 difficulty scale (the middle difficulties carry the weight; tail_share the weight beyond the fitted grid, where the curve is held at its end values); aoe_jeffreys_* Beta(½,½) — the weight √(σ(z)(1−σ(z)))/π, heavier in the tails (tail_share likewise); aoe_haldane_* Beta(0,0) — flat in z, improper, so the average over the stated range, the axis tasks' span (range_lo/hi: the easiest to the hardest task of record; the fitted grid's ends where no tasks are known); and beside the three, aoe_pool_* the pool's own difficulty distribution (equal weight per axis task at its difficulty of record; n_tasks beside); each read from the element's curve summaries on the engine's z grid — the number on the posterior-median curve, env_lo/hi on the 10th and 90th percentile curves, an ENVELOPE and not the draws' band of the measure (the elements store no per-draw curves; the engine can export the per-draw measures on the fits still to run)
form.joins: a row is keyed by the pointer (the served table) and the arm (the configuration key the table's row carries); element_path and element_sha12 are the pointer's binding of record for that row
form.struck: true on a row whose arm carries struck true on its served pointer — a position of a course stopped as failed or diverged, no datapoint on any page or count under the project maintainers' word of 19 Oct 2026 as the maintainers applied it; false on every other row; the row kept, the mark carrying the exclusion as on the pointers — a reader leaves struck rows out of its planes (the column since 19 Oct 2026)
